title: Doubling Rule
question: A sequence doubles each time: 2, 4, 8, 16. Which number continues it?
correctExplanation: Exactly 32. Each term is twice the one before, so sixteen doubles to thirty-two.
incorrectExplanation: The answer is 32. Adding rather than doubling would give a smaller number and break the pattern.
lessonContent:
Find the rule before extending.
Test the rule on several terms.
Distinguish adding from multiplying.
Extend only after the rule fits.

title: Sum of Pair
question: Each term is the sum of the two before it: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8. Which number follows?
correctExplanation: Exactly 13. Five plus eight gives the next term in this classic recursive series.
incorrectExplanation: The answer is 13. Adding the last two terms is the rule; extrapolating a different pattern fails on earlier terms.
lessonContent:
